title: Report when uv tool upgrade replaces a hand-written wrapper in ~/.local/bin
notes: On the office Mac the uvtools plugin ran 'uv tool upgrade atrium' and ~/.local/bin/atrium, a wrapper script that exported SYNTOPICA_DATA, became a symlink to the uv tool entry point (2026-11-24 01:32). atrium then answered from no instance. Fixed locally by exporting SYNTOPICA_DATA in ~/.zshenv.
done_when: A decision is recorded: either uvtools detects non-symlink entry points before upgrading, or wrappers are documented as unsupported
